title: ScientificDiscoveryLab: Three Instrument Defects Found by Self-Audit

related_identifiers.note: SCOPE NOTE: this identifier covers a DIFFERENT project (coherent optical vortex propagation, EXP-0007). It is listed only to make the boundary explicit. This deposit neither amends nor supersedes it, and the two share no data, code, or conclusions.

notes: No scientific discovery is claimed. The contribution is evidence about measurement instruments, including three defects that had been making the authors' own results look better than they were. Two preregistrations in this deposit are labelled informed rather than blind and state what had already been seen. All historical artifacts are verified byte-identical; no baseline control was refreshed.
